scope: Independent bounded static source, byte-provenance and existing synthetic-evidence review. No target import, synthetic/product test execution, production edit, Cargo, raw stderr/monitor/exe read, account operation or realm.

findings.conclusion: No blocking finding. Production storeOnly is an explicit boolean, defaults false, and true emits only the new Store dataset. Integration plan retains the original 803387 base capture and old 3/4/7 consumers unchanged; separate wx output/status/source bindings are required.

Only fourteen fixed stages, five fixed operations and ten exact public keys survive. Canonical ASCII wire numeric strings and safe nonnegative integer public numbers are checked; traceId and samples must be positive. Extra/partial/reordered/unknown targeted account_store rows request stop once and mark capture incomplete without copying text, private values or error strings.

BigInt range comparisons avoid unsafe Number multiplication/subtraction. Independently floored microsecond endpoints can differ from floored elapsed microseconds by one: inclusive durationMs*1000+1000 and totalUs+1 accommodate the producer rounding boundary. Max single duration, aggregate total and nested spans remain distinct.

Unchanged shared capture limits remain 8KiB line, 1MiB queued write, 32MiB total, 15s finish. Capture termination waits for actual stderr end and writer finish. Separate captures have separate allocations/write work and ceilings; no zero-overhead claim is made.

Independent validator keeps one fixed line buffer and bounded fixed stage/operation counters, streams SHA/byte/row counts, rejects malformed rows/status and compares queued counts with actual ended bytes. A short/read-failed digest covers only consumed bytes. Legitimate incomplete captures remain incomplete even when their persisted row grammar is valid.

limitations: Only completed thresholded records emit after guard release. Missing/zero rows cannot rule out an ongoing holder, identify a lock holder or establish absence of a stall.
Trace is a process-local opaque counter, not an account, connection or durable event identity. observedAtMs is receiver time; startedUnixMs is producer wall time.

Capture/validator completeness supplies diagnostic evidence only. It grants no ACK, game completion or capacity acceptance. New runtime integration, backend Release and fresh run are not validated here.
Existing 51/51 synthetic execution was performed by the author, not rerun by this reviewer.
